summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The NPF Core Equity ETF (NPFE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in US equities selected through fundamental research. The portfolio emphasizes companies with strong financial characteristics and long-term growth potential. NPFE was launched on Mar 11, 2026 and is issued by NPF.

holdings.infoBox: NPFE is an equity ETF with a total of 330 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 10.83%, Alphabet at 5.22%, Applied Materials at 4.41%, Amazon.com at 4.18%, and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company at 4.13%.
